verdict.rationale: Drata documents a native 'Connections' concept (an 'Understanding Connections in Drata' help article) and pitches integrations that automate evidence collection, so connecting external systems is a first-party capability. However, the pack shows no integrations catalog and none of the named categories: cloud, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM or ticketing. The Custom Connections API is a developer building block, and the agent's read-only access to system preferences concerns the endpoint agent, not integration scopes, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: a documented integrations catalog, evidence of named connectors for cloud/identity/HR/code hosting/MDM/ticketing, documentation of read-only OAuth/API scopes per integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
